description: This pie chart illustrates four core attributes or categories, likely representing the foundational properties of the reasoning benchmark referenced in the paper's title. The chart is divided into four equal slices, each visually representing approximately 25% of the total area. The top-left slice is colored yellow, contains the internal label "Complexity" alongside a ladder icon, and is associated with an external text box labeled "Uncrushable" featuring a matching yellow border. The top-right slice is light blue, features the internal label "Instance" with a shield and checkmark icon, and connects to an external box labeled "Unhackable". The bottom-left slice is red, includes the internal label "Scalable Oversight" with a clipboard and checkmark icon, and is linked to an external box reading "Auto-verifiable". Finally, the bottom-right slice is light green, displays the internal label "Coverage" with a globe and gear icon, and corresponds to an external box labeled "General". The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit numerical percentage labels, as the text and icons are embedded directly within and adjacent to the segments. Additionally, the four slices are visually separated by a white cross-shaped gap, slightly offsetting them from one another, and they are arranged in a symmetrical, equal-sized layout rather than being ordered by descending or ascending size.
